corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward is the principal artillery killer; Durin supplies supplementary arts during actual contact. Already-born shells remain dangerous after source death or withdrawal.
Fang blocks upper-central traffic. Vanilla assists only when unblocked; Steward clears armor once artillery priority permits. Preserve a free slot before another arrival.
Vanilla blocks lower-central traffic. Fang assists when unblocked; persistent Durin and Steward provide armor damage. Vanilla's two-block capacity cannot substitute for clearance.
Plume intercepts upper-outer enemies and destroys eastern upper restraint3 when no enemy takes priority. Skill bursts separate the paired officers; Ansel's extension supplies recovery.
Spot contains lower-outer enemies. Durin supplies damage during healing mode and must prevent the three-block queue from filling.
Plume releases the eastern upper restraint. Keep the western restraint as temporary holding only while artillery cannot kill the detained civilian; destroy it in the final rotation.
Durin destroys eastern lower restraint4 before artillery exposure becomes lethal. Spot neither attacks nor blocks the civilian. Final western Plume releases restraint2.

artillery_budget.conditional_sufficient_example: 41 Steward hits, including eight enhanced hits, plus six Durin hits produce 13026.62 damage under the supplied formula.
artillery_budget.limitation: This contact count is a hypothesis. Durin can prefer closer-to-exit officers, and caster injury can terminate contact.
artillery_budget.required_observation: Count actual artillery damage, rather than attacks issued or time nominally in range.

formation_structure.critical_medical_risk: A 910-damage shell leaves full-health Steward at 190 HP. Before another such shell, he needs more than 720 healing: two ordinary Ansel heals supply 724. A single boosted Ansel heal is insufficient. Repeated five-second shells can exceed what one 2.85-second physician can deliver at the required instants; this plan does not claim that the exposure is survivable merely from average HPS.

economy.limitation: The ledger assumes survival and successful scheduled Vanilla activations. Losing either required grant is an opening survival failure, not an arithmetic correction.

medical_geometry.limitation: Spot stops attacking while healing. Neither nominal combined HPS nor a ready skill proves that the ratio selector delivers the necessary heals.

formation_structure.opening_mechanism: Vanilla faces Fang's lane and deploys before the first runner arrives. Fang faces Vanilla's lane. Self-blocked targets take priority, so assistance is credited only while the assisting pioneer has no blocked target.
formation_structure.structure: Four lane holders, including a healing guardian; one physician and two casters. No opening retreat or planned death funds deployment.
formation_structure.validation: Read-only range and conditional opening-ledger calculations completed. No stage simulation or full-stage success verification was performed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed normal-mode rarity 1-3 IDs are available. Every deployed ID is listed; no reserve-mode unit or alias is permitted.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction on compatible terrain. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Fang and Vanilla must remain deployed through every grant used by the opening ledger. Ansel must actually deploy at frame 1293; an unaffordable attempt does not establish medical coverage.
Credit pioneer cross-lane attacks only when the current target selector permits them. A blocked pioneer cannot be assumed to assist the adjacent lane.
Record delivered heals between shell impacts. One boosted Ansel heal cannot rescue Steward from a second 910-damage shell after a full-health first hit.
Maintain live interception in all four lanes and enough free blocks for the next arrival; healing cannot remove a queued enemy.
Ordinary operators must never target or block civilians. Both eastern restraints and both western restraints need actual destruction; detained civilians remain vulnerable.
A death invalidates later skills or retreats for that deployment. Do not credit their effects or a retreat refund. A same-ID return requires its real cooldown and deployment payment.
The frame-9000 withdrawals depend on actual hostile clearance and resolved dangerous projectiles, not the nominal schedule.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets safely arrived. Operator deaths are evaluated separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Deliver actual cross-lane opening damage, retain both central blockers, obtain the first two pioneer grants and successfully deploy Ansel.
Reduce lower officer occupancy, clear eastern restraints and accumulate real artillery damage. Spot's healing trades away his attacks.

Sustain exposed casters through delivered heals, resolve residual shells and kill artillery before western civilian detention becomes lethal. The Steward healing constraint is a decisive failure risk.
Maintain both central blockers and persistent lower arts through all remaining spawns. Finish armor before paired runners exhaust available blocks.
Complete legal redeployment cooldowns, clear western restraints and observe two distinct safe arrivals. Elapsed time alone does not establish completion.

skill_intents.intent: Supported automatic DP while alive and deployed; no manual activation.
Grant six DP and briefly increase attack. Each activation is separated by more than the ten-second duration plus twenty inactive seconds.
Accelerate the paired upper officers and final outer clearance; no kill-DP talent is credited.
Use the supported nine-cell healing mode for self and adjacent lower support. No dodge, simultaneous damage or central healing is credited.
Increase actual single-target healing and extend coverage to Plume. No extra-heal talent or attack-clock reset is assumed.
Ordinary supported arts attacks only; maintain lower damage without a speculative mid-stage withdrawal.
Supported high-defense priority and automatic enhanced attacks; count actual hits on artillery and armor.

tactical_thesis: Replace Noil Corne with Vanilla and make the adjacent central pioneers assist each other before committing to their own blocked targets. Deploy Ansel before the opening officer handoff, deploy Durin before Steward, and retain lower arts coverage throughout the final waves. This is a complete, unsimulated CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE revision. Opening affordability is conditional on living, deployed pioneers; artillery contact, delivered medical service and eastern restraint clearance remain unverified decisive dependencies.
